title: Includes, Stacks, Custom Directives aur Vite Assets
objectives: `@include` aur `@each` se partial views use karna
Vite se CSS/JS load karna (`@vite`, `npm run dev/build`)

sections.heading: Include aur partial views
sections.body: Chhote reusable tukde (navbar, footer, product card) ko `partials` folder mein rakho aur `@include` se lagao. Components zyada powerful hain, par simple tukdon ke liye include kaafi hai.
explain: `@includeIf` – view na ho to error nahi aata. `@includeWhen(condition, view)` – condition true par.
`@each('view', $list, 'item', 'empty-view')` – list ke har item ke liye view render karta hai, khali ho to doosra view.

sections.heading: Stacks aur @once
sections.body: Page ka koi child apna script/style layout ke sahi jagah daalna chahe to stack use hota hai. `@once` bar-bar include hone wale partial se code sirf ek baar daalta hai.

sections.heading: Custom directive
sections.body: Agar koi kaam template mein baar-baar aata hai, to apna directive bana sakte ho. `AppServiceProvider::boot()` mein register karo.
explain: Directive ka callback ek **PHP code ka string** return karta hai jo compile hoke view mein chalta hai.
Directive badalne ke baad `php artisan view:clear` chalao, warna purani compiled view chalti rahegi.
Chhote kaam ke liye component ya helper function aksar saaf rehta hai.

sections.heading: Vite: CSS aur JS load karna
sections.body: Laravel assets (CSS/JS) Vite se bundle hote hain. Layout ke `<head>` mein `@vite` likhte ho. Development mein `npm run dev` (ya `composer run dev`) chalta hai, aur production ke liye `npm run build`.

code.code:
npm install
npm run dev      # development: hot reload
npm run build    # production: public/build mein files

explain: `@vite([...])` – dev mein Vite server se, production mein `public/build` se files lagata hai.
Naye project ka CSS setup (jaise Tailwind) skeleton ke hisaab se aata hai. Apne project ki `package.json` aur `vite.config.js` dekho.

callout.text: `@vite` lagaya par `npm run dev` ya `npm run build` nahi chalaya to 'Vite manifest not found' error aata hai.

sections.heading: View cache
sections.body: Blade views compile hokar `storage/framework/views` mein cache hoti hain. Production deploy par `view:cache` chalate hain, aur development mein koi gadbad lage to `view:clear`.

code.code:
php artisan view:cache
php artisan view:clear

versionDiff.heading: Vite aur assets: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: Blade ke includes, stacks aur directives teeno versions mein same hain. Assets ka tooling skeleton ke saath aata hai.

items.11: `@vite` aur `npm run dev/build`. Skeleton mein Vite pehle se configured hai.
items.13: Same. Server, queue aur Vite ek saath chalane ke liye `composer run dev` bhi hai (13 installation docs ke hisaab se).

errors.error: Vite manifest not found at: public/build/manifest.json
errors.cause: Assets build nahi hue ya Vite server nahi chal raha.
errors.fix: `npm install && npm run build` chalao, ya development mein `npm run dev` / `composer run dev` chalu rakho.

errors.error: Custom directive ka purana behaviour chal raha hai

debug.body: Assets aur views ki problem mein pehle caches saaf karo, phir Vite ka status dekho.

tasks: `@each` se products ke cards dikhao (`products/card.blade.php`) aur khali list ke liye `products/empty.blade.php`
`@money` custom directive banao aur price dikhao
Layout mein `@vite` lagao aur `npm run build` chalakar page kholo

options: List ke har item ke liye view render karne
quiz.why: `@each('view', $list, 'item', 'empty')` list ke har item ke liye view render karta hai.

quiz.q: Custom directive badalne ke baad kya chalana chahiye?
quiz.why: Compiled views cache hoti hain, isliye `view:clear`.

quiz.q: Production ke liye assets kaise build karte hain?
quiz.why: `npm run build` production files `public/build` mein banata hai.

interview.a: Simple static tukde ke liye include, jab props/slots/attributes ya logic chahiye to component.
Child view `@push('name')` se content bhejta hai aur layout `@stack('name')` par use dikhata hai.

interview.q: Custom Blade directive kaise banate hain?
interview.a: `Blade::directive('name', fn ($expression) => "<?php ... ?>")` ko service provider ke `boot()` mein register karke.
Development mein Vite dev server se, production mein built manifest se CSS/JS ke tags lagata hai.
Production deployment par, saari Blade views pehle se compile karne ke liye.

summary: `@include`/`@each` partial views ke liye, components zyada flexible.
`@push`/`@stack`/`@once` se scripts aur styles sahi jagah jaate hain.
`@vite` ke saath `npm run dev` ya `npm run build` zaroori hai.
